wikitext: [[File:"Necro Highland" concept art.jpg|226px|thumb|right|[[Necromancer Vabbian armor|Vabbian armor]] concept art by [[Jason Juan]]]] {{TOCright}} A full set of [[Necromancer]] armor consists of a (face) scar pattern, tunic, gloves, leggings and boots. ==Armor bonuses== [[Basic armor|Basic]] Necromancer armor provides up to a maximum of 60 [[Armor rating|armor]], 10 extra [[energy]] and 2 extra [[energy recovery]].
